notes: Kernel missed deadlines are not audio-device underruns. Linux tests do not use an audio device.
Stage wall times are nested and may overlap across workers; do not add them as CPU time.
rusage covers preparation and warmup as well as timed DSP. System/cgroup snapshots may include other processes.
Switch instance allocation/queueing occurs outside timed DSP and is separately reported; process CPU includes it.
Desktop historical comparisons also include the independent 606cc40 fixes; short Linux before/after isolates the Control optimization.
No change to default worker count, buffering, FFT, source/path order, acoustic quality, or room resource format.
